findings.finding: BASE task must be executable; acceptance declarations cannot be omitted
findings.resolution: baseline status and every required acceptance command enforced

findings.finding: trusted wrapper could otherwise come from HEAD
findings.resolution: workflow loads wrapper from BASE, which loads policy from BASE; workflow edits remain privileged trust boundary

findings.finding: Git replacement object can alter BASE resolution if HEAD executes first
findings.resolution: Trusted BASE policy runs first, every policy Git command ignores replacement refs, real git-replace counterexample rejects widened scope.
